note: Every person of this surname the archive can name, gathered from every record set it holds — parish burials, headstones, reconstructed households, FamilySearch record hits, the Gologorica pedigree, the Eleven of Gračišće, the Omiš chart, the direct line, and the namesakes. **Identity here is by record, not by resolved individual**: two entries may be one person, and where the archive knows they are it has merged them. Nothing here is new evidence — it is all of the evidence, in one list, for the first time.
